name: Molly
source:
Laura's best friend. She doesn't care too much about what others think of her, at least she didn't. She has a carefree attitude and a desire to help Laura in any way possible. She deals with growing up similar to how Laura does, however she doesn't show it. She finds a niche to cling to immediately,, but is this truly her, or a cheap mask to hide her troubles?

[From [url=http://www.indiedb.com/games/anticipation-apprehension-adolescence-book-1]IndieDB[/url]]
